in_hebrew.name: Bach
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bach הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old German word 'bach' meaning 'stream' or 'brook'. In Christian contexts, the name Bach may symbolize the flowing waters of faith and spiritual growth.

in_greek.long_meaning: Bach είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old German word 'bach' meaning 'stream' or 'brook'. In Christian contexts, the name Bach may symbolize the flowing waters of faith and spiritual growth.

in_latin.name: Bach
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Stream, brook
in_latin.long_meaning: Bach est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old German word 'bach' meaning 'stream' or 'brook'. In Christian contexts, the name Bach may symbolize the flowing waters of faith and spiritual growth.
